Name: Yet Another Sprint Mod
Author: XxHarvzBackxX
Description:
[center][/center][center]﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿[b][u][size=6]YASM[/size][/u]
[size=4]Yet Another Sprint Mod
[/size][/b]
Do you ever think that you move too slowly in Stardew Valley? Do you ever wish there was an option to move faster than the game allows you to? Well look no further! This mod will allow you to sprint using nothing but a key on your keyboard! But take care, because while sprinting, the sprint will deplete your stamina, based on your skill levels (all skills)! Don't worry [i]too[/i] much, however, because at 25 stamina, you will receive a warning that your stamina is low, if you are sprinting!

[u][b][size=4]How to Install[/size][/b][/u][list=1]
[*][size=2]Download the 'YASM' file from the Files tab.[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip the file using something like 7zip, WinRar, or Archive Utility (for Mac).[/size]
[*][size=2]Drag the folder to your mods folder.[/size]
[*][size=2]Configure the mod to your tastes in the config.json file.[/size]
[*][size=2]Sprint away, and enjoy the mod! (If you enjoy using it, feel free to endorse it / vote for it for MotM!)[/size]

[/list]
[b][u][size=4]Configuration[/size][/u][/b]
[size=3]In the 'config.json' of the mod, you can configure the mod how you please.
[/size]How you can configure it:
[code]
﻿"ToggleKey" - This field determines the key held to sprint.
Valid entries: any key on this site ﻿https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Key_Bindings#Button_codes
Default setting: "LeftControl"﻿﻿﻿

[/code][code]
"speedBoost" - This field determines the speed boost applied to the player (not multiplied by).
Valid entries: any integer from 1-10 (higher numbers work but will likely cause issues, a crash possibly.)
Default setting: "2"﻿

[/code][code][/code][code]
"staminaDrainConfig" - This field relates to the amount of stamina deducted from the player per second.
Valid entries: any integer from 1-100 (higher numbers work but will likely cause issues, a crash possibly.)
Default setting: "1"﻿
[/code][code]
﻿﻿"skillBasedStaminaDrain" - This field determines if the mod will reduce stamina based on the player's skill levels.
Valid entries: true, false.
Default setting: "true"﻿﻿
[/code][code]﻿﻿"LowStaminaWarning" - This field determines if the mod will warn you if you're sprinting and your stamina is low.
Valid entries: true, false.
Default setting: "true"﻿﻿
[/code][size=4]

[b]Incompatibility[/b]
[/size]No known incompatibilities. If you think a mod will be incompatible, or you find one that is, be sure to let me know and I can look into it.
[/center]That's all! If you have any questions / worries / doubts, feel free to contact me on Nexus, leave a comment on my mod, or contact me on Discord at XxHarvzBackxX#3665!
